Specifications are from the Cytron product page. Where the page says only 'PLCs, sensors, actuators', the device examples are typical uses, not a tested list.
The page does not say which panel each port is on; positions come from the product photos. The two MIPI CSI ports, M.2, mPCIe and AI HAT+ are inside the case.
Device counts (2 USB, 2 GigE, 4 IP, 1 depth camera) are limits of IRIV EdgeAI Studio, not of the hardware. The USB-C is not field power: use VIN.
